Appraiser remarks
The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center, and the tow hook bracket and trunk
lid edge show crush consistent with a straight rear impact. Damage to the taillight
housing and the surrounding quarter panel seam also lines up with the reported impact
direction, so most of what is visible fits the account given. Repair plan is to replace
the bumper cover, straighten the bracket, refinish the trunk lid edge and reinstall
the lamp assembly. The labor hours on the estimate run somewhat high for this scope, so
the shop should be asked to justify them. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known to
us, and the invoices submitted show no repeated charges.
